title: 12 Best Winnipeg Craft Beer
description: Discover Winnipeg's top craft breweries in 2026. From pioneering Half Pints to modern Sookram's, explore local favorites, must-try brews, and vibrant taprooms for every taste.

places.name: Half Pints Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dreadnaught India Pale Ale or St. James Pale Ale

places.name: Trans Canada Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The TCB IPA and a wood-fired pizza, especially the 'Perogy Pizza'.

places.name: Stone Angel Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Best Bitter' or the 'St. James Stout' for a true British pub experience.

places.name: Sookram's Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their hazy IPAs or a sour, like 'Desert Oasis.' The flight is a must to try new releases.

places.name: Torque Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Diesel Fitter Stout' is a local classic, or try the 'Whitewall Witbier' for something refreshing.

places.name: Barn Hammer Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Lager' for a crisp, clean brew, or their rotating IPA for hop enthusiasts. They often have tasty snacks available.

places.name: Nonsuch Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their Belgian-style Saisons or Dubbels, paired with an item from their exquisite food menu, like the tartare.

places.name: Devil May Care Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their rotating fruit sours or a hazy IPA. They also have a great craft cocktail program if you want a break from beer.

places.name: Little Brown Jug Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The '1919 Belgian Pale Ale' is their flagship and a must-try. Pair it with their delicious pretzels and mustard.

places.name: Brazen Hall Kitchen & Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Valkyrie Red Ale' or a seasonal IPA, paired with their famous 'Brazen Burger' or poutine.

places.name: One Great City Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'River City Lager' for a refreshing option, or check out their rotating seasonal sours and IPAs. They often have good snacks available.

places.name: Low Life Barrel House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their limited-release barrel-aged stouts or a carefully crafted sour. Ask the staff for a recommendation based on your preferences.
